title: SZ_A8R8G8B8 mip-chain offset + per-mip LOD-clamped sampling + intra-mip swizzle decode oracle
purpose: Allocate a 64x64 SZ_A8R8G8B8 texture with a 7-level mip chain (64x64 -> 1x1) in xemu's expected mip layout (linear sum of prior mip sizes; see hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/texture.c:178-186). Pre-swizzle each mip with a 4-quadrant non-uniform pattern (4 distinct tinted colors) using NV2A's Z-order swizzle masks (mirror of hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/swizzle.c). Per mip N (0..6), apply per-mip tint (255 -> 32) to base RGBA so cell N shows a distinct shade. Bind the full mip chain ONCE per cell (MIPMAP_LEVELS=7); per cell, only the SET_TEXTURE_CONTROL0 MIN_LOD_CLAMP / MAX_LOD_CLAMP fields are rewritten to force sampling at mip N. Filter is BOX_NEARESTLOD + NEAREST tap so the sampler picks exactly one mip with no inter-mip interpolation and no intra-mip filtering. Per cell, draw 4 sub-quads each sampling a fixed quadrant UV (TL/TR/BL/BR centers in [0..1] normalized space); expected cell paint is the 2x2 quadrant pattern of mip N. Cell 7 is unused; retains BLACK clear. Catches MIN/MAX_LOD_CLAMP not honored (Metal pre-2026-05-21 fix: all cells sampled mip 0), mip-chain offset off-by-one (cell N shows mip N+/-1's tint), SZ_A8R8G8B8 intra-mip swizzle mis-addressing (quadrant positions swap), channel mis-route at smaller base sizes, and mip 6 (1x1) degenerate dim handling.
expected_fail_notes: Metal: PASSes byte-exact (changed_pixels_pct=0.0000, signal_match_pct=100.0000) as of 2026-05-22 — task #16 closed by the Hermes cycle 5 fix that landed (a) the Metal renderer non-cubemap-2D `s.border` 2x-upload in `hw/xbox/nv2a/pgraph/mtl/texture_pg.c::decode_face_levels` + `pgraph_mtl_texture_bind_from_pg` (mirrors `gl/texture.c:451-456` and `vk/texture.c:111`), and (b) the xbed_texture library one-liner `fmt |= XBED_FMT_BORDER_SOURCE_BIT;` in `xbed_texture_bind_stage0` so `s.border = false` (= `border_source = COLOR`) by default for current callers (matching nxdk samples/mesh/main.c:145 `0x0001122a`). Evidence at benchmark-runs/20260522T054316Z-task16-swizzle-mipmap-validation/. The renderer doubled-upload code path remains live so a future dedicated `swizzle-bordered` XBE (intentionally `BORDER_SOURCE = TEXTURE` with 128x128 swizzled VRAM data) will exercise it without needing a library API change. GL: cell 0 (mip 0) renders the 4-quadrant pattern correctly, but cells 1-6 (MIN_LOD_CLAMP = MAX_LOD_CLAMP = N>0) render BLACK -- the renderer truncates `levels = MIN(levels, max_mipmap_level + 1)` in pgraph_get_texture_shape and then uploads/samples wrong data. Task #17.
